title: Sean McVay hopes to never play again in Australia; Aaron Donald's game status undecided

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay hopes to never play again in Australia; Aaron Donald's game status undecided
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay praises Australia for creating a "great atmosphere," but he's in no rush to ever play a game there again after 27-7 loss to the 49ers.
